changes: Updated `readings.py` so live and replay ingestion convert directly with `float(text)`, preserving fractional and signed values. Added regression tests for positive/negative live fractions and replay fractions.
diagnosis: Both ingestion paths converted parsed values through `int`, truncating `"2.75"` to `2` before returning `2.0`. Display and currency rounding logic was unrelated and unchanged.
remaining_uncertainty: None identified. Parsing retains Python’s standard `float` semantics.
verification: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passed all 6 tests. `python3 -m py_compile readings.py tests/test_public.py tests/test_ingestion.py` also passed.
